---
title: Add Products
description: >-
  Add new items to your catalog by uploading product photos, writing titles, and
  setting prices or point values.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1374" height="759" style="width: 1374px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Products > Add Product.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="293" height="204" style="width: 293px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Upload Product image and enter product name, detailed features and specifications.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="505" height="386" style="width: 505px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Set product price and select the specific date product should go live on your app.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="207" height="131" style="width: 207px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="445" height="190" style="width: 445px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
